caption: The battle_ai_leaders website clip, re-staged: its second player Cavalry troop was scripted 81 wu east, overlapping the hill's south-west corner, so a few riders started the battle on the rock and the terrain backstop held them at its edge (overlap and shape defects on that troop and its neighbour). It now deploys on open ground just west of the hill; the AI decisions the clip demonstrates play out as before. cannae_scale gets the same fix by declaring a map without the hill, since that clip is about tier scale, not terrain.
